scope: Qwen streaming CPU wait policy; single-session only
limits: Each A/B configuration ran one 120-second controlled Chinese input; these figures are not an all-audio average or a new ten-minute soak test.
The CPU metric includes the API service cgroup and descendants, not feature extraction alone, and excludes model loading, client and monitor work.
Wait policy changes no decoding, punctuation, model weights, feature devices, Qwen concurrency or stability horizon.
Worker PASSIVE was observed directly; EngineCore proc environment is overwritten by process naming, so inheritance is not claimed as directly measured.
Qwen cancellation normally closes the legacy WebSocket without a final; queued audio may be intentionally discarded.
Protocol regression does not replace a fresh microphone, desktop-paste, tmux or cross-network test.
